verdict.reasons: Core defect: the drip tape lateral is rendered as a rigid, circular cross-section poly pipe/line rather than a thin flattened drip tape, which is a wrong product family for the installed lateral. The pressure gauge is mounted directly onto the flat top of the upright AFP carton roll, which is physically implausible and constitutes packaging used as a hardware/pressure port rather than a standard irrigation header. Because the requested technical evidence (pressure gauge on a continuous header and separate flattened tape lateral via take-off fitting) is not faithfully integrated and the packaging is being used as part of the plumbing, the image fails the minimum quality score. The primary AFP branding on the carton is clear, authentic, and legible, and the required watermark is present.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
